description: The bar chart illustrates the number of samples across six distinct reasoning categories, with the vertical axis representing the "Number of Samples" on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10² to 10⁴, and the horizontal axis listing the categories. The tallest bar corresponds to "Mathematical Reasoning," with 7025 samples, followed by "General Reasoning" with 1709 samples. "Natural Scene Reasoning" has 413 samples, "Visual Reasoning" has 232, "Puzzle Reasoning" has 91, and "Chemical Reasoning" has 49 samples. The bars are arranged in descending order of sample count from left to right, and all are colored light blue. The chart visually emphasizes the significant disparity in sample sizes, with "Mathematical Reasoning" having substantially more samples than the other categories.
